categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Eastern Shenghong Co., Ltd. operates primarily in petrochemical refining, chemical new materials, and polyester fiber manufacturing. The company has a vertically integrated industrial chain covering oil refining, chemical raw materials, and downstream polyester fiber products. It also engages in energy production, including power and heat supply, and has expanded into new energy and advanced materials sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced refining technologies including atmospheric and vacuum distillation, delayed coking, hydrocracking, and catalytic reforming. It operates large-scale integrated refining and chemical production facilities, including a 16 million ton/year refining complex and the world's largest single MTO (methanol-to-olefins) unit. Polyester fiber production uses melt spinning and chip spinning processes, with proprietary technologies in differentiated and functional fibers, including recycled polyester and bio-based fibers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Eastern Shenghong serves a broad range of industries including textiles, automotive, electronics, construction, and renewable energy sectors. Its polyester fibers are used in apparel, home textiles, and industrial applications. The petrochemical products supply downstream manufacturers of plastics, synthetic fibers, and fine chemicals. The company also supplies materials for photovoltaic modules and lithium-ion battery components, targeting new energy markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are primarily based in China, with major production facilities located in Suzhou and the Lianyungang petrochemical industrial base. It exports products to over 30 countries including South Korea, Turkey, Vietnam, Pakistan, and Italy. It also has subsidiaries and operations in Singapore and other international locations to support global trade and supply chain integration.
categories.supply_chain_position: Eastern Shenghong operates across the upstream, midstream, and downstream segments of the petrochemical and polyester fiber supply chain. It controls raw material refining and chemical production (upstream/midstream), as well as polyester fiber manufacturing and sales (downstream). The company’s integrated model includes raw material supply, chemical intermediates, and finished fiber products, enabling strong vertical integration and supply chain control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on high-end, differentiated products, innovation in new energy and new materials, and green low-carbon development. It invests heavily in R&D for advanced functional fibers, bio-based materials, and photovoltaic encapsulation materials like EVA and POE. The company is advancing AI integration for smart manufacturing and management, and developing carbon capture and utilization technologies to reduce emissions and enhance sustainability.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of petrochemical products, chemical new materials, and polyester fibers to industrial customers. The company uses a direct sales model for large and strategic customers, with payment typically on delivery or via credit terms for trusted clients. It also earns income from energy sales and property leasing. The company’s revenue is largely product sales-based, supplemented by investment income and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Eastern Shenghong is one of the leading private petrochemical and polyester fiber enterprises in China, with a competitive position strengthened by its large-scale integrated refining complex and diversified product portfolio. It competes with major domestic and international petrochemical companies in refining and chemical production, and with leading fiber manufacturers in differentiated polyester products. Its technological capabilities in new materials and green fibers provide differentiation in the market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately 137.7 billion RMB, a slight decrease from the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was negative due to market volatility and raw material price fluctuations. Total assets reached over 204 billion RMB, reflecting growth and ongoing capital investments. The company maintains a strong asset base and continues to invest in capacity expansion and innovation despite short-term profit pressures.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Eastern Shenghong emphasizes its vertically integrated supply chain, scale advantages, and advanced technology to provide high-quality, differentiated chemical and fiber products. It leads in producing high-performance, functional polyester fibers, recycled fibers, and photovoltaic encapsulation materials with proprietary technology. The company’s commitment to green manufacturing, carbon capture, and AI-driven smart operations further differentiates its offerings and supports sustainable development goals.
